items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: we had records of some marches that Souza made that we used to listen to.

ctx.x: records I used to listen to. Another thing, we had records of some marches that Souza made that we used to listen to. Moreso than the Dixieland records. Like I told you, another thing, the first things I remember about Dixieland was the Original Dixieland Jazz Band, Livery Stable Blues and those old tunes, and then here comes old Ben Pollack -- stuff like that.

You said before... This is going way back, to the first tape, but I still want to talk about this for a little bit longer. You said before that the French Opera in New Orleans was a place where they played Classics, operettas, operas and all that. After the French Opera burned down, was there any other place that people could go?
